rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something with elements in appropriate proportions, especially a balanced diet.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caan1 daan1 jing4 joeng5 hou2 gwan1 hang4

rows.note: Use this when the focus is physical stability or an object being unlikely to tip over rather than nutritional or proportional balance.

example.english: The vase has a wide base, so it stays balanced.
example.traditional: 個花樽個底夠闊，擺得好平衡。
example.jyutping: go3 faa1 zeon1 go3 dai2 gau3 fut3 baai2 dak1 hou2 ping4 hang4
